segments.thi-ap38:9.3: Karontaṃ kusalaṃ kammaṃ, rundhantaṃ [niddhantaṃ (sī. pī.), nudantaṃ (syā.)] katapāpakaṃ.
segments.thi-ap38:10.1: “‘Yo ce vuḍḍho daharo vā, pāpakammaṃ pakubbati;
segments.thi-ap38:10.3: Dakābhisiñcanā sopi [bhoti (sī. ka.) therīgā.239], pāpakammā pamuccati’.
segments.thi-ap38:11.3: Tañca sutvā sa saṃviggo [susaṃviggo (syā.)], pabbajitvārahā ahu.
segments.thi-ap38:12.3: Tato puṇṇāti nāmaṃ me, bhujissaṃ maṃ akaṃsu te.
segments.thi-ap38:13.1: “Seṭṭhiṃ tatonujānetvā [tato anumodetvā (sī. syā.), tato anumānetvā (pī.)], pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ;
segments.thi-ap38:16.3: Ñāṇaṃ me vimalaṃ suddhaṃ, buddhaseṭṭhassa vāhasā.
segments.thi-ap38:17.3: Mānena nīcakulajā, na hi kammaṃ vinassati [panassati (syā.)].
segments.thi-ap38:19.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.thi-ap38:21.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ puṇṇikā bhikkhunī imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.
